text:
rachel: FYI planning an APAC mTLS rotation this week after the cert-chain anomaly in staging. Need RBAC window + KMS audit checks. Who can pair on triage?

linh: I can take the RBAC policy diffs. Suggest a short-lived service role 'rotator:unwrap' scoped to CMK and a deny-all fallback.

tom: I'll own KMS traceability. We saw missing decrypted_by principal in some unwrap logs during the last run (apac-edge).

rachel: Noted. Also security: we should check for CVE-2025-1234-related client auth edgecases in the proxy. Patch available but may change handshake ordering.

audit-bot: Alert: 2025-03-18 07:22Z - 12% of apac-edge handshakes lacked tls_peer_subject. Created ticket INC-9055.

linh: Can someone paste the RBAC snippet convention? I want to avoid granting logs:* globally.

tom: Minimal example (pseudo):
```
role: rotator-unwrap-temp
actions: [kms:Decrypt, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents]
resources: [arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:acct:key/xxxx]
ttl: 6h
```

rachel: Good. We'll use 6h TTL for the short window, rotate creds via our session manager.

linh: Also add condition on aws:SourceIp to only allow rotator VM subnet.

tom: For audit correlation I'll export unwrap traces with request_id and kms_key_id. Quick grep: `grep -E \"unwrap|decrypt\" /var/log/keystore/*.log | jq -r '.request_id,.principal,.kms_key'`

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: apac-edge v2.3.4 -> v2.3.5 (canary=2 nodes) at 2025-03-19T02:00Z

rachel: Stop canary if tls_peer_subject missing >3% in 15m window.

linh: On the RBAC review: we should also add audit:Write permission to the rotator role so unwrap events are guaranteed written before key use.

tom: Hmm audit:Write seems broad. Maybe best to require a presigned log stream id passed by controller. That avoids wide log perms on the role.

rachel: OK tom explore presigned streams. Meanwhile, we need a fallback plan if proxy patch breaks client cert forwarding.

linh: Fallback: pin proxy to v2.3.3 (previous stable), and roll keystore changes behind the proxy pin.

audit-bot: AU-4178 created for audit reingestion job to populate tls_peer_subject for historical handshakes. Linked to INC-9055.

tom: Quick triage steps I'm running locally:
1) run openssl s_client with -servername to test SNI forwarded cert
2) tail proxy access logs and keystore unwrap logs
3) correlate by connection id `conn_id` field

rachel: Can we also run a vulnerability check across proxies to ensure the CVE patch is present? I don't want to mix patch + RBAC changes in one window.

linh: I'll produce a small matrix: proxy version vs tls_peer_subject present rate per node.

oncall: I can hold a maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Will page if rollback triggered.

rachel: Excellent. Action list: linh RBAC policy + matrix, tom KMS trace exporter & presigned stream proposal, me review change control and patch schedule. Meet preflight 01:30 UTC tomorrow.

tom: One more note: if we backfill audit, add a field `ingest_source=keystore` so consumers can filter reingested records.

linh: Agreed. Also add an allow-list for reingest job to only modify records with missing tls_peer_subject.

rachel: Thanks. Closing thread for now, will reopen with preflight notes. If anything spikes, @oncall escalate immediately.

deploy-bot: Canary started 2025-03-19T02:00Z - nodes: apac-edge-21, apac-edge-22

audit-bot: Note: monitoring rule pinged - tls_peer_subject rate slack at 02:08Z (3.8%)

rachel: Copy that. Pulling logs into the triage ticket.
